title: oxdoc PPTX slides JSON / JSONL output
description: Schema for `oxdoc extract slides --format json` payloads and `--format jsonl` records in oxdoc schema version 1. slide_ordinal is the 1-based position of the p:sldId element within p:sldIdLst; skipped slides leave gaps in the emitted ordinal sequence.

file.description: File name derived from the provided input path; <stdin> for stdin input.

slides.description: One slide record per non-skipped slide, in p:sldIdLst order; skipped slides are simply absent and the remaining records keep their presentation ordinals.

jsonlRecord.description: One compact JSON object per non-skipped slide on its own stdout line (no wrapping array).

file.description: File name derived from the provided input path; <stdin> for stdin input.

slide.description: One slide record. slide_id is omitted when p:sldId/@id is absent or unparsable; notes is omitted when the slide links no readable notes part; slide_ordinal keeps its p:sldIdLst position so skipped slides leave gaps.

slide_id.description: p:sldId/@id (xsd:unsignedInt); omitted when the attribute is absent or unparsable.

slide_ordinal.description: 1-based position of the p:sldId element within p:sldIdLst, counting every element; skipped slides leave gaps (for example 1, 4).

slide_path.description: Resolved package part path of the slide, for example ppt/slides/slide2.xml.

text.description: Slide body text; "" for a textless slide. The record set stays aligned with the presentation.

notes.description: Speaker notes text; omitted when the slide links no readable notes part (possibly "" for a readable-but-empty notes part).
